title: Chinese oracle bone script
summary: Late Shang diviners carved questions and answers on ox bones and turtle shells; inscriptions from King Wu Ding's reign are radiocarbon dated to 1254-1197 BCE.
why: The oldest attested Chinese writing, direct ancestor of characters used today.
interchange: Four independent inventions of writing are most commonly recognised: Mesopotamia (c. 3400-3100 BCE), Egypt (c. 3250 BCE, still debated), China and Mesoamerica

notes.problem: Interchange says writing was invented 'at least four times' incl. Egypt; History of writing: four are 'most commonly recognized' and 'no definitive determination has been made as to the origin of hieroglyphics' (era-A 123 is marked debated).
